data.why: dashboard.py only reads the pipeline's precomputed tables already committed under data/ and results/ (GDSC-8.5-derived); it has no upload widgets, so nothing needs to be copied into prep/data or prep/seed.

goals: Identify which GDSC compounds are GBM-selective (more effective against GBM lines than the pan-cancer panel) and at what statistical confidence
Inspect a drug's putative target, pathway and out-of-fold predicted scores on the Drugs page to shortlist candidates
Compare how well chemical structure (descriptors, fingerprints, GNNs) predicts GBM selectivity and potency across grouped vs. scaffold-disjoint cross-validation, against permutation nulls
Examine structural similarity (Tanimoto, MCS, GNN-embedding cosine) among GBM-selective and top-ranked candidate compounds
Review combination-therapy hypotheses ranked by target diversity, pathway complementarity, potency and structural novelty, plus their structural interaction-screen flags
Check hypergeometric pathway enrichment of GBM-selective drug targets against the full screened library

review.summary: A faithful, well-evidenced tree that covers all six dashboard views and the README's three questions, with accurate specific labels and screens that show what each node says. It needs light fixes before filing: a misleading 'linked' feature name, open questions the code already answers, a goal phrase that drops potency, and a few UI chores promoted to tasks.
